rationale: The prompt asks which channel has a message reacted to with thumbsup by an admin/owner. The base seed contains exactly one reaction record (U01AGENBOT9, 'eyes', member role) and no thumbsup reactions anywhere, so the absent resolution is correctly justified — no conversation satisfies the full route. All role facts check out against base_seed: the eyes-reaction message and its author (Lukas) in #engineering, the reactor's member role, and two genuine admins (Robert Walsh, Morgan Freeman) who have zero reaction activity, showing the role condition is meaningful but unmet. The binding_note correctly ties emoji+reactor role to the same user on the same message, and the negatives (wrong emoji, wrong role, no reaction) are all real, non-redundant, and path-derived without hinting the answer. The access_plan (list→history→reactions.get→users.info) is realistic and matches documented API capabilities. The only unresolved point is the supplied mechanical_design_errors flag claiming a referent mismatch, which is not corroborated by any visible inconsistency in the assignment vs. design fields — this is reported as an open annotation issue rather than treated as a validity failure, since the substantive prompt/route/seed alignment is otherwise sound.
